source_facts: NASA describes approximately 160 to 215 kW station capacity after the final upgrade.
interpretation_limit: NASA headline capacity is not a measured sunlit bus-power trace. These numbers only set illustrative scenario scales; no ISS operational load or storage capability is inferred.
assumptions: 60 minutes sunlight, 35 minutes eclipse, 80 or 120 kWh nominal battery, SOC window 20-90 percent, 95 percent efficiency each way, 200 kW charge and discharge limits. All modeled; no flight telemetry, actual battery specifications or cost quotes.
rights: Original scenario values and analysis; source article and images not redistributed.
